styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting in the style of a sunset landscape: sky of layered flat gray and silver clouds with ribbons of gold, orange and red glowing between them, figures and trees as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.WOLSEON: a Korean Joseon woman of forty, black hair parted in the middle, a small bun at the nape pierced by one plain wooden hairpin, a red shaman robe with wide sleeves, a calm sharp face
characters.BUNI: a young Korean woman of twenty, black hair parted in the middle, a small bun at the nape pierced by one plain wooden hairpin, a white jacket and dark blue skirt, a gentle round face
characters.MOTHER: a Korean woman of forty five, black hair parted in the middle, a small bun at the nape pierced by one plain wooden hairpin, a gray hemp jacket and skirt, a worn face
characters.MANBOK: a young man of twenty, black hair with a white cloth band tied around his forehead, a white hemp jacket and gray trousers tied at the ankles, a round honest face
characters.CHILBOK: a man of twenty five, black hair with a white cloth band tied around his forehead, a brown hemp jacket, a sly narrow face, thin mustache
characters.SATTO: a man in his fifties in a crimson official robe and a wide black gat, a full black beard
characters.CLERK: a clerk in a dark blue robe and a small black hat
characters.BOWL: a small round wooden bowl holding white rice and a folded white cloth, tied to a long straw rope

scenes.S01: Only one man and one woman in front: WOLSEON pointing her whole arm straight at CHILBOK, who leans back on the ground in shock, a blurred crowd far behind, a stream. Daylight.
scenes.S02: A close view of WOLSEON from the chest up filling the frame, her eyes calm and knowing, a clear stream flowing right behind her. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S04: A single woman standing alone, the only person in the whole picture: WOLSEON on a riverbank holding brass bells, thatched houses and willows behind. Daylight.
scenes.S05: Only three people: WOLSEON alone in red walking on a lane with her head low, and one man and one woman in white at the side turning their faces away. Daylight.
scenes.S06: Only one woman in the picture: WOLSEON kneeling at the edge of a river lowering BOWL into the water with both hands, the rope trailing into the current. Daylight.
scenes.S07: Nobody else: a close view of a woman's bare feet standing ankle-deep in a clear shallow stream, the hem of a red robe and a white skirt just above, water swirling around the ankles over round pebbles, filling the frame. Daylight.
scenes.S08: Nobody in the picture: a close view of clear water rushing down over round mossy stones in a mountain stream, white foam, wet rocks and green ferns all touching the edges of the frame. Daylight.
scenes.S09: Three people, one ox: MANBOK in trousers leads a yellow ox out a gate, BUNI and an older woman in gray watch. Morning.
scenes.S10: Two men on a night road: MANBOK tipsy and smiling, CHILBOK eyeing the pouch in his jacket. Moonlight.
scenes.S11: CHILBOK standing on the bank of a shallow stream with stepping stones, waving both arms and shouting, three villagers running toward him. Morning mist.
scenes.S12: Exactly two women: MOTHER collapsed on the ground weeping on a stream bank, BUNI kneeling beside her and holding her shoulders, crying. Morning.
scenes.S13: Exactly three men: CHILBOK leaning in and whispering to two village men in white hemp clothes, one hand beside his mouth, his eyes sly. A thatched wall behind. Daylight.
scenes.S14: Exactly three people: BUNI with her wrists tied, head down, led along a road by two clerks in dark blue robes, one on each side of her. Daylight.
scenes.S16: Only one woman in the picture: MOTHER sitting on a floor gripping a folded white man's jacket to her chest, her face set and determined, a latticed paper door behind. Daylight.
scenes.S17: One man and one woman, only two people, at night: CHILBOK at a low doorway holding out a string of brass coins, and WOLSEON inside looking at him silently. Lamplight.
scenes.S18: A close view of a string of round brass coins with square holes lying on a low wooden table, filling the lower half of the frame, WOLSEON's face blurred just behind it looking down. Nobody else, lamplight.
scenes.S19: Exactly two women sitting on a floor facing each other: WOLSEON listening quietly, MOTHER talking in tears. Paper door behind. Daylight.
scenes.S20: Only one woman in the picture: WOLSEON standing on flat stepping stones in the middle of a shallow stream, looking down at the water flowing past. Willows on both banks. Daylight.
scenes.S21: Only one woman in the picture: WOLSEON standing on stepping stones seen from the side, looking upstream toward a bend where the stream opens into a deep dark green pool under rocks and willows. Daylight.
scenes.S23: An empty landscape: looking up a shallow stream, flat stepping stones in front with water flowing toward the viewer, and further up a bend with a deep dark green pool under willows. Rocks and reeds fill both sides. Daylight.
scenes.S24: Only one woman in the picture: WOLSEON standing beside a deep dark green pool, looking at a narrow footpath that leads through tall reeds toward the back of one thatched house. Late afternoon.
scenes.S25: A close view of WOLSEON from the waist up sitting on a floor and filling the frame, a string of brass coins on the floor before her, her face troubled. Lamplight.
scenes.S26: Only one woman in the picture: WOLSEON sitting awake beside a small oil lamp at night, her eyes open and thinking, a cluster of brass bells beside her. Dark room, lamplight.
scenes.S27: A riverside ritual ground in daylight: in front, a long red lacquered offering table with tall stacked towers of apples, pears and persimmons on footed red dishes, white rice cake blocks, a dried fish, two white candles in red candlesticks. The table stands alone in the foreground; far behind it, small villagers sit in rows on the bank by a stream with stepping stones.
scenes.S28: WOLSEON dancing with a cluster of brass bells raised high, her wide red sleeves flaring, and one drummer sitting behind her with a janggu drum. Exactly two people in front, a stream behind. Daylight.
scenes.S29: Exactly two women: WOLSEON standing still, eyes half closed, trembling, and MOTHER behind her crying out, hands at her mouth. Riverbank, daylight.
scenes.S30: Exactly two women: WOLSEON looking down at BUNI, who kneels with wrists tied, looking up in tears. Riverbank, daylight.
scenes.S31: WOLSEON turning and pointing with her whole arm at CHILBOK, who sits on the ground at the front with his face gone pale. Exactly two people in front, a blurred crowd behind.
scenes.S32: A close view of CHILBOK's face filling the frame, frozen in fear, eyes wide, sweat on his forehead. Nobody else, daylight.
scenes.S33: Exactly two people: WOLSEON throwing brass coins onto the ground before CHILBOK, who stares. Riverbank, daylight.
scenes.S34: Exactly three men: CHILBOK running away along a stream bank, and two CLERK figures chasing right behind him. Reeds and willows, daylight.
scenes.S35: Only two people and nobody else: CHILBOK kneeling with his hands tied on the bare ground of a county office courtyard, and SATTO seated alone on the wooden veranda above. Daylight.
scenes.S36: Only two people and nobody else: WOLSEON kneeling low with her head bowed on the ground of a county office courtyard, and SATTO seated on the wooden veranda above, leaning forward. Daylight.
scenes.S37: Only one man and one woman in the whole picture: WOLSEON kneeling on the bare ground of a county office courtyard, raising her face to speak, and SATTO seated high up on the wooden veranda above her, listening. Daylight.
scenes.S38: Only one man in the picture: SATTO standing up on a wooden veranda, his face stern and decided, one hand on his robe. Daylight.
scenes.S39: Exactly two men: SATTO standing on stepping stones in a shallow stream, watching a round gourd ladle float downstream away from him, a CLERK crouching beside him. Daylight.
scenes.S40: Exactly two men: two CLERK figures crouching in a dim straw shed, lifting a dirty cloth bundle of brass coins out of a hole in the dirt floor. Light from the door.
scenes.S41: Only two people: CHILBOK kneeling upright on the bare ground of a county office courtyard with his head bowed deeply, hands tied, and SATTO seated high up on the wooden veranda above, looking down. Daylight.
scenes.S42: Exactly two women: MOTHER and BUNI holding each other tightly and weeping in a small courtyard of a thatched house. Daylight.
scenes.S43: Four villagers in white hemp clothes gathered in a village lane whispering together, one pointing toward the stream, their faces amazed. Thatched houses behind, daylight.
scenes.S44: Exactly two people: SATTO laughing on the wooden veranda, and WOLSEON kneeling below with a small quiet smile. Daylight.
scenes.S45: Only three people in the whole picture: WOLSEON walking along a village lane, and a man and a woman stopping at the side to bow their heads to her. Daylight.
scenes.S46: Exactly two women seen from behind: BUNI and WOLSEON sitting side by side on a stream bank, watching the water. Autumn dusk.
